errors.network: Could not reach the assistant. Check your connection. No automatic retry was made.
errors.timeout: The request timed out. Check saved history before resending; the reply may still complete.
errors.authentication: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.permission: Your account or current restaurant context cannot use this conversation. Check your role and active branch.
errors.notFound: This conversation is unavailable in your current context. Start a new conversation or check your branch.
errors.busy: Another reply is pending or your context changed. Reload history before continuing.
errors.rateLimit: Too many requests. Wait a moment before trying again.
errors.configuration: The assistant is not configured. Ask your administrator to check its server configuration.
errors.documentation: The documentation index is unavailable or changed. Ask your administrator to validate it.
errors.provider: The AI service could not complete the reply. You can check history and try again later.
errors.invalid: The assistant returned an invalid response. Reload history before resending your question.
errors.validation: Enter a nonempty question of at most 4,000 characters. The server may enforce a smaller configured limit.
errors.unavailable: The assistant is temporarily unavailable. Check saved history before trying again.
